Class FileLoader.Block

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.io.FileLoader.Block
Enclosing interface:
FileLoader
public static final class FileLoader.Block extends Object
Immutable format block. HEX has embedded addresses; BIN has unaddressed bytes. TAP/TZX have an ID and original body bytes. TAP uses ID 0x10 and its body includes flag/data/checksum; TZX bodies contain all fields after the block ID. Format determines which representation applies.
